newsitem.title: UK: Oasis lead singer Liam Gallagher marries actress.
newsitem.headline: Oasis lead singer Liam Gallagher marries actress.

text.p: LONDON, April 7 - Liam Gallagher, lead singer of British rock group Oasis, finally married actress Patsy Kensit on Monday in a ceremony away from the prying eyes of the British press.
The 24-year-old bad boy of British rock and his 28-year-old bride tied the knot at a London registry office after cancelling an earlier ceremony in February because of media intrusion.

"Mr Liam John Paul Gallagher and Miss Patricia Jude Francis Kensit were married in the Westminster Register Office at Westminster Council House, Marylebone Road, London NW1," the registry office said in a statement. Two friends witnessed the ceremony.
The Marylebone office has had its fair share of celebrity weddings. Linda and Paul McCartney, and Antonio Banderas and Melanie Griffiths, were also married there.
Oasis' record company said Gallagher and Kensit had intended the ceremony to be a complete secret.
"The couple are extremely happy and very pleased that they've finally been able to tie the knot without any intrusions. No honeymoon is planned," Creation Records said in a statement.
It was the first marriage for Gallagher and the third for Kensit, who was previously wed to Jim Kerr of the rock group Simple Minds, the father of her four-year-old son James.
The couple called off their February nuptials when, despite obtaining licences for six different venues to keep the media guessing, the press still discovered where it would take place.

Gallagher's older brother Noel, the creative force behind the group, also scrapped his plans to wed public relations woman Meg Matthews on Valentine's Day after plans for their nuptials were leaked to the press.
Oasis, the Manchester-based band, is considered one of the most successful British rock bands since the Beatles in the 1960s. Their first two albums sold 20 million copies.
The Gallagher brothers have been a constant fixture in the Britain's tabloid press where they made headlines for their foul language, dabbling in drugs and the cancellation of a U.S. tour.
